items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: when William Brunish started to play with me, when I took him to play with Alto, he was eight years old.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Now, did you have anybody else in that band who was older than you were? Were there boys who were older than you were? No. No. They were all your age or younger? Yeah, they were. Yeah. Fifteen and sixteen-year-old kids. That's the song.

All children. Now, when William Brunish started to play with me, when I took him to play with Alto, he was eight years old. Is that right? My boy was only eight years old. And Abby Brunish was about a year or two older then. Then Richie was about the same thing, two years or two older. See?
